transport.websocket: one IRC message per frame; no trailing frame bytes

session.invariant: A successful same-account resume preserves the logical attachment without duplicate JOIN or MODE events.

group_e2ee.message_tag_semantics: internal MLS-family marker only; does not claim RFC 9420 wire interoperability
group_e2ee.server_role: authenticated membership policy and opaque control-record delivery only

delivery.recipient_gate: onyx/e2ee negotiated and locally joined to the channel
delivery.welcome_absence: explicit TARGET_UNAVAILABLE failure; no offline persistence in v1

invariants: The server never decrypts or stores a group secret.
A client without the current room epoch key renders a locked placeholder.
A membership change advances the epoch before subsequent content is accepted.
